comment: fountain.c dipfountain() uncurses a dipped item through mkobj.c uncurse(), which calls set_moreluck() for a carried luckstone. A dwarven Valkyrie in debug mode wishes for a cursed luckstone and a fountain, dips the stone (rnd(30) picks the uncurse case), and checks ^X: u.moreluck goes from -3 to +3, so enlightenment reports extra luck. The seed was the first of 7301001-7301087 whose first dip reaches the uncurse case (port scan; 5 of 87 did).
